en.title: AlUla Artist Residency Program highlighted at IMA Design Awards
en.summary: Participants from the AlUla Artist Residency Program received recognition at the Institut du Monde Arabe Design Awards in Paris, with Saudi architect Aseel Alamoudi winning the Emerging Talent Award.

stories.title: King Mohammed VI: Saudi security is an integral part of Morocco’s security

en.title: King Mohammed VI: Saudi security is an integral part of Morocco's security
en.summary: Morocco's King Mohammed VI condemned Houthi militia attacks against Saudi Arabia, stating that Saudi security and Morocco's security are interconnected.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack in Dera Ismail Khan, Reaffirms Support for Pakistan

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack in Dera Ismail Khan, Reaffirms Support for Pakistan
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a terrorist attack targeting a security checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan in northwestern Pakistan that resulted in casualties. The country reaffirmed its support for Pakistan.

stories.title: Dutch FM Regrets Israel's Decision to Revoke Diplomats' Accreditation

en.title: Dutch FM Regrets Israel's Decision to Revoke Diplomats' Accreditation
en.summary: The Dutch Foreign Minister expressed regret over Israel's decision to revoke the diplomatic accreditation of Dutch officials in the West Bank following Dutch sanctions on Israeli settlement goods.

stories.title: Netherlands ‘regret’ over Israel’s decision to revoke diplomats’ accreditation

en.title: Netherlands 'regret' over Israel's decision to revoke diplomats' accreditation
en.summary: The Netherlands expressed regret after Israel revoked diplomatic accreditation of Dutch officials in the West Bank following Dutch sanctions on Israeli settlement goods. The Dutch Foreign Minister clarified the action was not directed against Israel.

stories.title: Taylor Swift becomes most-awarded artist in MTV VMAs history

en.title: Taylor Swift becomes most-awarded artist in MTV VMAs history
en.summary: Taylor Swift set a new record at the MTV VMAs as the most-awarded artist in the event's history. She dedicated her top award to Dolly Parton at the Los Angeles ceremony.

stories.title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington to meet US counterpart

en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan is in Washington to discuss regional and international matters with US officials. The talks are intended to strengthen ties between the two countries.

en.title: Saudi Defense Minister Discusses Defense Cooperation with Malaysian Counterpart
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's defense minister held discussions with Malaysia's defense minister regarding bilateral defense cooperation between the two nations.

stories.title: ‘Any attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on Morocco,’ King Mohammed VI says

en.title: 'Any attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on Morocco,' King Mohammed VI says
en.summary: Morocco's King Mohammed VI expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia, stating that attacks on the Kingdom are attacks on Morocco. He condemned Houthi strikes against the country and reaffirmed Morocco's support for Saudi security.

en.title: Why would CMA restrict algorithmic trading?
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority is introducing restrictions on algorithmic trading to enhance market safety and efficiency while preventing disruptions. Draft provisions were released for public consultation in September with implementation scheduled for November.

en.title: TASI: 4 stocks fall to 52-week lows

en.summary: Pan Gulf Marketing obtained SAR 70 million in Shariah-compliant financing from Emirates NBD with a one-year unsecured term for working capital purposes.

en.summary: Saudi Fisheries shareholders rejected a proposal to increase company capital by 500% through a SAR 334.93 million rights issue at an extraordinary general meeting on September 27.
